grok.notes: Protocols, endpoints, code reading, exact numbers. 15-30 min per deep task. Add --add-dir <code repo> at launch.

luna.notes: Local data and stats, careful cohort definitions, 0 refuted claims in 6 tasks. Slow on big tapes: 35 min - 2 h.

swe-max.notes: Web research, browser reverse engineering (signed APIs, protobuf over MQTT), Discord digging. Most wrong claims came from devins: re-check its numbers. 15 min - 2.5 h.

haiku.notes: Claude Haiku 5.5 on devin: cheap ($0.1 in / $0.5 out per 1M), 1M context, fast. Good for doc review, checklists, API-flag checks. Weaker on deep multi-step reasoning: give it narrow briefs and verify its claims.

cc.notes: Command Code, headless (cmd -p, one run per prompt, follow-ups resume the session). Long-horizon coding, 1M context. Not benchmarked in this fleet yet: check its numbers.
